column2: The Romanians use mainly outdated German equipment. Therefore, you have to buy/upgrade to German equipment as frequently as possible. You can do this in three different occasions. If you play well enough you can buy/upgrade to Soviet equipment in the last scenario. The strategy should be, buy the best Romanian equipment, increase its experience, of course avoid being destroyed and whenever possible upgrade it to German. Buy/upgr a de to equipment that can fight effectively the whole war, such as, 17K18 guns, Tiger tanks, FW190 A or D. The priority should be on guns first, tanks second, but try to buy at least one good fighter plane. Follow during the first part of the campaign a m ixed strategy. Build a balanced army, but at the same time follow a Recon/AD approach. The Romanians Recon units are during the first scenarios second to none, they can even fight against certain tanks. Buy 3 or 4 and use them following Kobi's strategi es. They are also cheap. I grew up two leaders, Kobi would have been proud of them.

column2: This is a tough scenario. You have to move through rough terrain and face several strong tanks on the way. Those tanks are even stronger tha n the German ones provided with the auxiliary German Corps. Develop a technique to destroy superior tanks. Play very conservative during the first 3 or 4 turns. Circle your units with infantry and tanks, put the artillery in support behind. Attack the tanks with you TB and artillery to finish them with a core tank or recon unit. The Northern group should move to the central Russian victory hex first and then move East. The German group has to be very careful because of several tanks in its way. I ac hieved a victory in my last turn.

column2: I bought a 100 mm gun, two recons and 2 tanks. This is a very tough scenario. I had to change twice the Soviet tanks, downgrading them. I have also to provide the Soviets with several range 3 instead of range 4 guns, otherwise it was impossible to win. You have to spread out all over the map. Extreme prudence is required during the first three turns. The Soviets also have good defenses inside the city itself. Play defensively; slowly pinpoint the enemy guns and then attack. I moved straight a big Northern group into the first Soviet victory hex. I ran into trouble by 3 Soviet tanks counterattacking. It took me 3 turns to destroy them. Rain that precluded the use of TB was a big problem. I surrendere d the northern airfield for the time being. I had trouble also with two Soviet recons attacking my guns. The fight for the city was also big trouble, a lot of well-dug artillery. My recons played a tremendous part, moving in and out attacking the guns. One of them became a leader and increased its experience more than 300 points!!

column2: You can buy German equipment. I upgraded my guns to 17K18 and 15K18, my tank to PZIIIJ ;and upgrade a Romanian AD to a SKG6/2 mobile AD. I also boug ht 2 German PZIIIJ and a FW190 A fighter plane. The scenario is only moderately tough. A reflection on the power of the new equipment. I play-tested the scenario using the normal Sortavala map, by some reason the AI tried to send a big group through th e Southern lake. It put effectively out of play. The problem was that the lake hexes are considered to be river. This fact allows movement through the lakes. In this scenario the southern lake represents the Azov sea, not a lake, therefore, movement sh ould be precluded. After play-testing I have gotten from Steve Brown another map version that has the lake hexes turned to ocean. The scenario in all likelihood will be tougher. The file that will change the map is provided with the campaign.

column2: I bought 2 Romanians tanks PZIIIJ2, a 100 mm gun, an AD unit and 2 recons. The scenario is tough at the beginning. The right side group tried to take the 2 eastern victory hexes, while I concentrated the other group on a deep penetration to the West . You have to be careful during the first 2/3 turns. The Soviets have tough tanks there. I lost a core infantry unit there. I also got bogged-down on the eastern victory hex with the German group. I was attacked from all sides, by strong tanks. I lost a German tank there. After some tough moments I could take the two victory hexes and move forward to the last one. I got some problem with some good Soviet planes as well. After destroying the tanks the left group did not have much trouble. You only need to be a little cautious in attacking the city. I got a victory.

column2: I got a Pz IVG 2 as a prototype. The first range 2 tank. You can not deploy all your units, therefore, I used the prestige mainly for upgrades. I used the new tank right away. The right group has the easiest tasks, while the left one can be in trouble immediately. You have to be conservative during the first 2-3 turns with the left and central groups. Charge in the right. Especially move slowly and together your units on th e left. The 2 mountain infantry divisions can move quickly, but the others only move one hex at a time. Do not separate them, there are Soviet tanks immediately out of sight. A good thing is that the infantry can stand up to the tanks on the rough terra in. Do not try your luck, if you got into gun range you will be in big trouble. The recons were once again key units , by spotting the Soviet guns and attacking them. I used my German guns to destroy the Soviet artillery. The lack of mobility due to terrain prevented me from getting a brilliant victory though.

column2: I bought a Pz IIIJ2 tank and a fighter Romanian plane. I mostly over-strengthened my units to increase their chances to survive. The scenario is tough, but not as tough as I exp ected. You have to plan right though. The isolated three northern hexes are lost. Therefore, I tried to retreat from some. I built a defensive parallel line at the level of the last victory hex. After 2/3 turns I started slowly a counterattack across the whole line. I have to slowly and methodically destroy the Soviet tanks by surrounding them with tanks and infantry, selecting one and firing all the guns until weakened. After that your tanks and recons can attack and destroy them. The range 2 tank was very helpful against the still range 1 Soviet tanks. I lost a core Romanian tank and an AD unit though. Once again the recons were extremely helpful. Particu larly in attacking the Soviet supply points. They are covered by heavy artillery and the Soviets got some reinforcements there. I got a victory.

column2: You use only six units here; therefore, most of your prestige goes into over strengthening your units. I selected the three Tiger tanks, my 2 long-range guns and my experienced AD unit. The scenario is not tough, but you need to plan well. You send a strong group to take the two southern ports, i.e., 3 heavy tanks, a recon, two infantry units, two heavy guns and your Hummel there. In 3/4 turns you should have taken them. Meanwhile you have to move your fleet East, submarines first. You need to destroy the Soviet fleet. Once, you have taken the ports and destroyed or neutralized the Soviet fleet you sent by sea at least two heavy tanks and the Hummel gun toward the last port. You should from the beginning entrench you infantry inside the city. As soon as you have taken the ports send your long-range guns and spare tanks back inside the city. The Soviets w ill throw everything they have at you, but it is doubtful they can do anything. Be aware though that you need to hold all the victory hexes to win. If you lose a single one you are lost. The southern ports are especially vulnerable. Use the submarines to hold them. I manage to get a BV.

column2: This is a strange scenario. The idea is to depict a very heavy air battle. Unfortunately the game does not accommodate air fighting only, therefore, a commando action was added. You can deploy your a ir force and only 2 land units. I selected of course 2 Tiger tanks. I bought a Romanian Me-109G, to add to my FW190 A (1000, +5) and another Me-109G (320, +3). Your air force can not stand directly the Allied air onslaught. You have to hide your plane s especially the 2 Me-109G and the Henschel bomber. After 3-4 turns the AI custom of putting the planes directly on top of AD guns would have given you a break. Be careful, use the provided auxiliary German planes to lead the attack and only after your R o manian planes. The new plane I only used it when practically the sky was clear. It got 100 experience points though. You should not have much trouble with the land units. The combination, Tigers/Hummel/Recon should allow you to take the airfield victo ry hex without much effort once the air battle is won. The British Firefly is a fine tank, but it has low defense stats. I won a BV in the last turn.

column2: You should divide you forces into a smaller group on the East and a big one on the West. The scenario is tough at the start . You need to be very careful during the first 3-4 turns. The AI has lots of German tanks and planes. Their mobility really surprised me. I lost several core units, especially infantry, a Tiger Tank and the 15.2 cm gun.
